value.rationale: The normal-line construction is a genuine pseudometric with nontrivial parallel-body kernel. Exact normalization by a fixed natural invariant (perimeter) restores separation and yields a global quantitative equivalence of metric topologies. The optimal reverse coefficient and optimal half-Hölder forward exponent are both realized as limits inside one fixed-perimeter smooth class, distinguishing two different mechanisms of instability. The theorem directly addresses the geometry of the cited new pseudometric rather than recomputing a restricted example.
